note: GAMEPLAY TUNING and GAME INVENTION: a mission chain for each side, after the siege of Boston. Titles and flavour are display-only. Schema: protocol/schemas/missions.yaml (closed predicate and effect sets).

missions.title: Save the stores
missions.flavor: Gage's column is on the road for the powder and arms laid up at Concord.
missions.goal: Empty Concord's magazine (powder, cartridges, muskets) before a British army reaches the town. The two field guns hidden there go with the stores.

reward.summary: The country sees the stores saved: +5 Support, +3 morale

failure.summary: The regulars reached the stores: -3 Support

missions.title: Shut them in
missions.flavor: An army of the country holds the roads out of Boston.
missions.goal: Hold Roxbury, Cambridge and Charlestown together on 17 June 1775 or after.

reward.summary: Boston is shut in by land: +5 Support, +30 gold voted by the towns

missions.title: Deny the islands
missions.flavor: The garrison lives on the hay and livestock of the harbour shore.
missions.goal: Carry off Chelsea's provisions before the British forage them.

failure.summary: The regulars foraged the shore: -3 Support

missions.title: Powder for the army
missions.flavor: Not nine rounds a man in the whole camp.
missions.goal: Stand an army at Cambridge with 12 rounds a man in the town's magazine.

reward.summary: The army can stand a day's firing: +5 morale

missions.title: The noble train
missions.flavor: Heavy guns lie at Ticonderoga, three hundred miles of winter road away.
missions.goal: From December 1775, pay to send for the siege guns and wait for them at Cambridge.

reward.summary: The guns are in camp: +5 morale, +3 Support

missions.title: The heights
missions.flavor: Guns on Dorchester Heights command the town and the anchorage.
missions.goal: March the siege guns to Dorchester and fortify it. The British then sail unless they retake the heights.

reward.summary: The fleet cannot lie under these guns: the British prepare to sail

missions.title: Seize the stores
missions.flavor: The rebels' magazine at Concord is to be taken or destroyed.
missions.goal: Take Concord while its magazine still holds stores.

missions.title: Break the siege line
missions.flavor: The town cannot be held with the country in arms at every road.

reward.summary: A road out of Boston is open

missions.title: Take the heights
missions.flavor: Whoever holds Dorchester Heights holds the harbour.

missions.title: Forage raids
missions.flavor: Fresh provisions for the garrison must come from the farms.

missions.title: Hold Boston until reinforced
missions.goal: Hold Boston to the end of March 1776.
